State-machine, tree and game DP

Three DP shapes that look different on the surface but share one idea: describe "where you are" as a small set of states and write how each state is reached. The stock series (one trade, many trades, k trades, cooldown, fee) becomes one state machine. House Robber III and Binary Tree Cameras become a DFS that returns a few numbers per node. Predict the Winner becomes a score difference over intervals. Weighted job scheduling becomes sort + DP + binary search. Templates in Go, C++, Java and Python.

sections.title: The story: a trader with a mood ring
Stock I and II: two states are enough
Cooldown: draw the machine first, then code it
At most k transactions: a chain of 2k states
Tree DP: return a pair from every node
Game DP: store the score difference, not two scores
Weighted job scheduling: sort, DP, binary search
